versions.changelog:
- Updated documentation to ensure all CLI commands are wrapped with skill-quality-cli for tracking and compliance.
- Improved clarity and formatting in command usage examples and workflows in SKILL.md.
- Updated references/cli-installation-guide.md with more precise command instructions.
- Removed the legacy skill-card.md file for better documentation consistency.

- Initial release of Huawei Cloud OBS Lifecycle Management skill.
- Manage lifecycle policies: list, get, create, update, delete, diagnose, analyze cost, and preview affected objects.
- All operations use the hcloud CLI OBS module (obsutil passthrough) with skill-quality telemetry enforced.
- Safety: Creation, update, and deletion of rules always require a dry-run preview and explicit user confirmation.
- Designed to support diagnosing ineffective rules and optimizing storage costs through lifecycle policies.
